title: Present and navigate more easily
introduction: Presentation mode is here, along with a choice of run modes and keyboard access to menus.
imageAlt: A paused debugging session in Googol Light, with the floating toolbar at the bottom.

sections.title: Present your work
sections.body: Presentation mode in View enlarges editor and interface text. Panels remain resizable, and tool text scales with the available space. Leaving the mode restores your previous display settings.
sections.imageAlt: Larger editor text in presentation mode.

sections.title: Debug or run through
sections.body: The arrow beside Run opens Debug and Run. Run ignores breakpoints for that invocation without deleting them. Debug commands that cannot be used in the current state are disabled.
sections.imageAlt: Debug and Run in the run button menu.

sections.title: Menus and themes
sections.body: Open menus with Alt+F and similar shortcuts. Items are ordered by expected frequency of use. Googol Light and Night adopt Material 3 Expressive-inspired split buttons, a debugging toolbar and graph filter chips. Selection and hover states have also been corrected.
sections.imageAlt: Graph and menu in Googol Light.
